items.title: Salmiya Heights Reaches Topping-Out Milestone
items.body:
Maram Group is pleased to announce that Salmiya Heights has reached its structural topping-out milestone, marking a defining moment in the delivery of one of Salmiya's most anticipated residential addresses.

The twelve-floor tower, which offers forty-two residences with unobstructed views of the Arabian Gulf, has seen its final structural slab completed ahead of the original schedule. The project team — comprising our in-house development management division alongside appointed contractors — maintained a rigorous programme throughout the structural phase.

Attention now turns to the fit-out and finishing works. Warm limestone cladding, brushed bronze hardware and floor-to-ceiling glazing packages have all been procured and delivery to site commences next month. The rooftop terrace structure is also in place, ready for landscaping and services installation.

Units remain available across select floor levels. Prospective buyers are encouraged to contact our sales team to review layouts, finishes and payment plan options before availability closes.
